headline: Peak Credit Union to Acquire Southwest Heritage Bank
summary: Peak Credit Union entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Southwest Heritage Bank, expanding its reach into Arizona and New Mexico and deepening business banking expertise.
why: Bank mergers and acquisitions alter competitive landscapes and geographic footprints in the regional banking sector, impacting market share and lending capabilities.
